defs.doc:
FC.f90 goodf(), first part: 0 for a constant, infinite or zero feature
(not kept); 1 for a kept feature outside [fmax_min, fmax_max] (kept, not
screened); 2 for a kept feature that is screened. gfortran's maxval skips
NaN (and gives NaN when every value is NaN), and a comparison with NaN is
false: a feature with some NaN values is kept, as in the Fortran, and its
SIS score is 0 (its norm is NaN, so the norm test fails).
